name: Teen Volunteer Corps
what_you_do: Help the library during the school year and earn service hours. Set up events, prep crafts and organize shelves. Local history, story time and book display projects come up too.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You earn community service hours.
duration: At least 20 hours. Times depend on what the library needs.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-2027 school year are closed. No reopening date is posted as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Volunteer Corps waitlist form. The library emails you the link and dates when it opens.
